configurations.name: gamend-bench
runtimeArgs: GAMEND_DEV_BENCH=1 MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/bench PORT=4020 GAMEND_CONTENT_PLUGINS_DIR=modules/plugins_examples GAMEND_RATELIMIT_ENABLED=false GAMEND_FEATURES_LIST_LOBBIES_ENABLED=true GAMEND_FEATURES_LIST_GROUPS_ENABLED=true exec mix phx.server

configurations.name: gamend-sdk-check
runtimeArgs: export MIX_ENV=test MIX_TEST_PARTITION=77 GAMEND_CONTENT_PLUGINS_DIR=modules/plugins_examples GAMEND_RATELIMIT_ENABLED=false; exec mix run --no-start --no-halt -e 'c = Application.get_env(:gamend_web, GamendWeb.Endpoint); Application.put_env(:gamend_web, GamendWeb.Endpoint, Keyword.put(c, :server, true)); r = Application.get_env(:gamend_core, Gamend.Repo); Application.put_env(:gamend_core, Gamend.Repo, Keyword.merge(r, pool: DBConnection.ConnectionPool, pool_size: 5)); {:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:gamend_host)'

configurations.name: gamend-admin-shot
runtimeArgs: MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/test_admin_ui MIX_ENV=test MIX_TEST_PARTITION=79 exec mix phx.server
